content:
Context: 9. Benefits to the families of Government servants who go missing during service

will keep getting benefits as per CCS (Pension) Rules or CCS (EOP) Rules, as the case may be.  
Interest on delayed payment of retirement gratuity would be paid at the rates and manner applicable for Public Provident Funds deposits from  
time to time.
